mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_zip_import_entries WHERE entry_id = #{entryId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_zip_import_entries SET status = 'QUEUED', error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE import_id = #{importId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND supported = 1 AND material_id IS NULL AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND entry_id IN #{id}
UPDATE material_zip_import_entries SET status = 'IMPORTING', attempt = attempt + 1 WHERE entry_id = #{entryId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND material_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_zip_import_entries WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY entry_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_zip_import_entries SET status = 'QUEUED' WHERE status = 'IMPORTING' AND material_id IS NULL AND updated_at < #{before} AND attempt < #{maxAttempt}
UPDATE material_zip_import_entries SET status = 'DONE', material_id = #{materialId}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE entry_id = #{entryId} AND material_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_zip_import_entries WHERE import_id = #{importId} AND status = #{status}
